facts.paper_title: SeeTraceAct: Visibility-Aware Latent Planning from Cross-Embodiment Demonstration Videos
facts.statement: SeeTraceAct is a demo-conditioned Vision-Language-Action (VLA) framework that uses visibility-aware prediction of future end-effector traces to encourage precise spatial grounding.

facts.paper_title: SeeTraceAct: Visibility-Aware Latent Planning from Cross-Embodiment Demonstration Videos
facts.statement: SeeTraceAct learns a visual latent plan from a demonstration video to summarize task-relevant motion, which is decoded into future end-effector traces during training.
